settings.subtitle: For Men & Women · Ammonia-Free · Fast 15-Minute Color & Care

settings.heading: How to Use & Development Time
settings.content:
Step-by-Step Application
  • Start with damp, pre-washed hair. The hair should be clean and slightly towel-dried.
  • Apply the shampoo generously from roots to tips, massaging it in the same way as regular shampoo.
  • Ensure complete coverage, paying extra attention to gray areas at the temples and crown.
  • Leave on for 15 minutes without rinsing. Use a timer for consistent results.
  • Rinse thoroughly with lukewarm water until water runs clear.
  • No conditioner needed — the Argan Oil formula conditions as it colors.
Development Time

⏱ 15 minutes — Do not exceed 20 minutes. Rinse promptly for optimal color and hair health.

settings.heading: Ingredients & Botanical Actives
settings.content:
Key Actives
  • Argan Oil (Argania spinosa kernel oil) — Deep conditioning, frizz control, mirror shine
  • Biotin (Vitamin B7) — Strengthens hair shaft, reduces breakage, promotes thickness
  • Hydrolyzed Keratin — Repairs hair cuticle, seals split ends, adds silkiness
  • Olive Extract (Olea europaea fruit extract) — Antioxidant-rich scalp nourishment
Full Ingredient List

Aqua, Cetearyl Alcohol, Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil, Hydrolyzed Keratin, Biotin, Olea Europaea Fruit Extract, p-Phenylenediamine, Resorcinol, Sodium Sulfite, Hydrogen Peroxide, Citric Acid, Fragrance.

* Free from Ammonia, Parabens, and Sulfates

settings.heading: Patch Test & Safety Precautions
settings.content:
⚠️ Mandatory Patch Test (24–48 Hours Before Use)
  • Apply a small coin-sized amount to the inner elbow or behind the ear.
  • Leave on for 20 minutes, then rinse off and wait 24–48 hours.
  • If you experience redness, itching, swelling, or burning — do not use this product.
Important Warnings
  • Not suitable for individuals with a known allergy to p-Phenylenediamine (PPD).
  • Keep out of eyes. If contact occurs, rinse immediately with water.
  • Do not use if scalp is irritated, cut, or damaged.
  • Keep away from children under 16.
  • Pregnant or nursing women should consult a physician before use.
